comment: Student plan going to 5.99 is annoying but it is still the cheapest way I get music. I am not switching over a dollar.
That's it, I'm done. Apple Music is 10.99 and already has lossless, so Spotify just made the decision for me.
Honestly fine with it. Artists are getting crushed on per-stream rates and a dollar a month reaches them more than people think.
Family went from 15.99 to 16.99 and it is still way cheaper than five separate accounts, so we are keeping it.
Of course they are raising prices the same quarter they report record profits. Greed, plain and simple.
I will just go back to torrenting at this point. Not paying more every year for a service that keeps getting worse.
Still fine for me. Most of what I actually pay for is podcasts anyway, so the music part was always the cheap bit.
Going back to the free tier. Ads every few songs are a pain, but 11 bucks a month is more than I want to spend on music.
Switching to YouTube Music, which I already get through YouTube Premium. Spotify can keep the extra dollar.
Didn't even notice until the email. A buck here or there doesn't change anything for me.
Everything else went up too, Netflix, Disney, gas. This is the least surprising price hike I have seen in years.
Duo going to 14.99 stings a little, but split two ways we are each paying about 7.50, which still beats most alternatives.
A price hike with no lossless is the real insult. I would pay more if they added HiFi, but right now they are just taking more money.
The app has gotten worse every year and now they want more money. Why is the home feed still a mess?
Spotify is still the best music app I have used. Unlimited everything for 10.99 is a steal.
Canceling. Rent went up and this is one of the few things I can actually cut.
Price goes up, artists get a cut, fine. Hopefully it does not just end up with the executives.
Amazon Music Unlimited is already cheaper if you have Prime, so I am moving my library over there.
Going to Tidal for the lossless, and I am paying about the same. Spotify picked a terrible time for this.
Don't really follow this stuff. My kids handle the account, so I will ask them what it means for us.
Thrilled. Truly the best news of my week. Can't wait to see what the next price increase is.
Pretty sure I'm dropping Duo and going solo, since the split was the only thing making it worth it for us.
Been paying since around 2014. A dollar over a decade is a fair adjustment, and honestly it was overdue.
Honest answer: most of my music is from Soulseek anyway. Spotify is for the playlists, so this barely changes my habits.
Cancel and go free. I am not paying more for a product that keeps getting worse.
Premium has been worth way more than the 9.99 I was paying, so this does not change much for me.
